name: Will County, IL
findings: Will County has 1,682 nonprofit organizations. 697 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 549 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Will County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
